title: REST API Testing & Verification
instructions: Given a sample REST endpoint (e.g. POST /api/v1/payments/orders), design and test: (1) a successful request with valid payload, (2) an invalid input with missing/malformed fields, and (3) an unauthorized request. Submit your test cases, assertions, expected outcomes, and an explanation of the test coverage.

rubric.description: Tests a valid request and validates expected HTTP 200/201 response and payload schema.
Covers missing or malformed data and expected 400 Bad Request error behavior.
Checks that unauthenticated or unauthorized access is properly rejected with 401/403.
Tests include clear, meaningful assertions on status code, response time, and payload.
Learner clearly explains what the test suite verifies and why it ensures API integrity.
